name: Discovery Arcade
sensoryNotes: Covered architectural walkway with gaslit lanterns and scale models of 19th-century visionary inventions.
adhdTip: Excellent low-sensory bypass to escape parade crowds, extreme weather, and street congestion.

name: Disneyland Railroad – Main Street Station
sensoryNotes: Authentic steam train circling the park with scenic views and Grand Canyon diorama.
adhdTip: Restful transit option to move between lands without walking through dense mid-day crowds.

name: Horse-Drawn Streetcars
sensoryNotes: Gentle vintage trolley ride pulled by Shire horses along the tracks from Town Square to the Castle.
adhdTip: Operates morning to early afternoon. Very calming, open-air scenic transit.

name: Liberty Arcade
sensoryNotes: Quiet covered corridor detailing the history of the Statue of Liberty with audio dioramas.
adhdTip: A calm, dimly lit decompression space during loud afternoon parades.

name: Main Street Vehicles
sensoryNotes: One-way vintage fire trucks, limousines, and omnibus rides along Main Street.
adhdTip: Board at Town Square for a fun transition straight up to Central Plaza without tiring little legs.

name: Adventure Isle
sensoryNotes: Exploration island with suspension bridges, floating barrel pathways, and skull rock caves.
adhdTip: Ideal active decompression play area for kids needing movement without queue constraints.

name: Indiana Jones and the Temple of Peril
sensoryNotes: Outdoor runaway minecart coaster with sharp turns, rapid drops, and a fast 360-degree vertical loop.
adhdTip: Over-the-shoulder restraints cause noticeable head vibration; brace head firmly against the seat padding.

name: La Cabane des Robinson (Swiss Family Treehouse)
sensoryNotes: Self-paced banyan treehouse staircase climb with salvaged shipwreck rooms and waterwheels.
adhdTip: Continuous stair climbing is a great physical outlet, but offers no elevator or pushchair access.

name: Pirate Galleon
sensoryNotes: Full-sized pirate ship replica docked by Skull Rock for hands-on deck exploration.
adhdTip: Open play setting where children can walk around and inspect ship props at their own pace.

name: Pirates' Beach (La Plage des Pirates)
sensoryNotes: Fenced outdoor playground with rope bridges, pirate slides, and soft ground surfaces.
adhdTip: Divided into age zones (3-6 and 7-9). Great spot for parents to rest while kids burn energy.

name: Pirates of the Caribbean
sensoryNotes: Atmospheric indoor boat voyage through pirate caves with two sudden drops in the dark and cannon battle effects.
adhdTip: The drops occur in near darkness. Front rows experience light water splash.

name: Aladdin's Enchanted Passage
sensoryNotes: Quiet indoor stone passage with miniature animated window dioramas recreating scenes from Aladdin.
adhdTip: No queues or loud surprises; perfect low-stimulation walkthrough.

name: Big Thunder Mountain
sensoryNotes: High-speed runaway mine train speeding across island trestles and plunging into pitch-black underwater tunnels.
adhdTip: Final return tunnel is loud and pitch-black. Ear defenders recommended for noise-sensitive children.

name: Disneyland Railroad – Frontierland Depot
sensoryNotes: Scenic steam train stop with views over Frontierland rivers and geysers.
adhdTip: Station is generally less crowded than Main Street for boarding.

name: Frontierland Playground
sensoryNotes: Lakeside wooded play area with wooden teepees, climbing frames, and slides.
adhdTip: Scenic open space right beside the riverbank, ideal for an unstructured pause.

name: Phantom Manor
sensoryNotes: Slow-moving continuous doom buggies encountering ghosts, thunder, glowing skeletons, and a spooky ballroom.
adhdTip: The pre-show room plunges into sudden total darkness with a scream. Reassure children in advance.

name: Rustler Roundup Shootin' Gallery
sensoryNotes: Electronic laser rifle target gallery with animated western scenery, moving cactus, and sound effects.
adhdTip: Coin-operated (€2). Great focused hand-eye coordination activity.

name: Thunder Mesa Riverboat Landing
sensoryNotes: Authentic paddle steamer cruise around Wilderness Island with steam whistles and river views.
adhdTip: Plenty of open deck space to stroll around freely during the 15-minute sailing.

name: Alice's Curious Labyrinth
sensoryNotes: Winding hedge maze with Cheshire Cat, jumping fountains, and panoramic views from the Queen's Castle.
adhdTip: Zero waiting time and complete freedom of movement. Exit path available if feeling lost.

name: Snow White and the Seven Dwarfs
sensoryNotes: Minecart dark ride through the haunted forest encountering the Evil Queen and magic mirror.
adhdTip: Frequent sudden witch appearances in dark rooms can startle young or sensitive children.

name: Casey Jr. Circus Train
sensoryNotes: Brisk family roller coaster through fairytale miniature landscapes with cheerful music.
adhdTip: Choose the open sleigh cars if your child prefers open space rather than the enclosed circus cages.

name: Disneyland Railroad – Fantasyland Station
sensoryNotes: Victorian station stop nestled behind Peter Pan and the circus grounds.
adhdTip: Helpful transport to bypass the central castle hub during peak afternoon congestion.

name: Dumbo the Flying Elephant
sensoryNotes: Circular aerial carousel allowing riders to control their flying altitude with an onboard joystick.
adhdTip: Allowing the child to control the height lever provides great autonomy and focus.

name: It's a Small World
sensoryNotes: Gentle, brightly lit canal boat ride through singing animatronic doll dioramas.
adhdTip: A top-tier calming reset ride with a steadily moving queue and soothing water motion.

name: Sleeping Beauty Gallery
sensoryNotes: Upper floor castle walkthrough featuring stained-glass artwork, tapestries, and stone balconies.
adhdTip: Quiet, peaceful vantage point overlooking Fantasyland.

name: The Dragon's Lair
sensoryNotes: Underground cavern with a giant animatronic dragon that breathes smoke, blinks, and growls.
adhdTip: Dark and cavernous; exit immediately into the courtyard if your child feels nervous.

name: Lancelot's Carousel
sensoryNotes: Grand ornate carousel with galloping wooden horses and organ music.
adhdTip: Stationary bench chariots on the inner tier are ideal for kids who dislike vertical bouncing.

name: Sleeping Beauty Castle
sensoryNotes: Iconic fairytale castle archways connecting Main Street to Fantasyland.
adhdTip: Wide central archway can get crowded; use side drawbridge paths for easier walking.

name: Storybook Land Canal Boats
sensoryNotes: Tranquil outdoor canal boat cruising through miniature fairytale villages and castles.
adhdTip: Completely gentle and quiet, perfect for de-escalating sensory overload.

name: The Voyages of Pinocchio
sensoryNotes: Dark ride in wooden carriages featuring Stromboli, Pleasure Island, and Monstro the whale.
adhdTip: Loud shouting voices from Stromboli; reassure children of the happy ending.

name: Mad Hatter's Tea Cups
sensoryNotes: Spinning teacups under a glass pavilion with center steering wheel to control spinning speed.
adhdTip: Leave the center wheel untouched for a gentle gliding glide without intense dizziness.

name: Peter Pan's Flight
sensoryNotes: Suspended pirate galleons flying through dark rooms with glowing UV blacklight miniature London scenery.
adhdTip: Moving boarding walkway; prioritize early at rope drop or during evening fireworks.

name: Autopia
sensoryNotes: Gasoline go-karts along a guided concrete track with steering and accelerator pedal.
adhdTip: Vibrating engines and petrol odors; steering wheel bumps firmly against the center guide rail.

name: Buzz Lightyear Laser Blast
sensoryNotes: Interactive spinning space cruiser equipped with laser blasters to shoot glowing Z targets.
adhdTip: Great gamified task for active kids who enjoy focus goals and joystick spinning.

name: Disneyland Railroad – Discoveryland Station
sensoryNotes: Elevated steam train station overlooking Space Mountain.
adhdTip: Convenient station to ride back to Town Square when leaving the park.

name: Mickey's PhilharMagic
sensoryNotes: 3D animated cinema concert with Donald Duck, featuring wind gusts, water mists, and dessert scents.
adhdTip: Comfortable indoor air-conditioned cinema seats; 3D glasses can be removed if visual fatigue occurs.

name: The Mysteries of the Nautilus
sensoryNotes: Walkthrough Jules Verne submarine with glowing steampunk instruments and giant animatronic squid porthole attack.
adhdTip: Air-conditioned and cool, with very low wait times on busy afternoons.

name: Orbitron
sensoryNotes: Elevated spinning rockets offering high panoramic views across Discoveryland.
adhdTip: Flies significantly higher and faster than Dumbo with slow load/unload queue cycles.

name: Star Tours: The Adventures Continue
sensoryNotes: 3D motion simulator flight through Star Wars planets with hydraulic pitching and laser blasts.
adhdTip: If motion sickness or enclosure sensitivity hits, focusing on the cabin walls helps ground balance.

name: Star Wars Hyperspace Mountain
sensoryNotes: Catapult-launched indoor roller coaster with 3 inversions, glowing lasers, and loud Star Wars orchestral audio in pitch darkness.
adhdTip: Very intense sensory stimulation with rapid light flashes. Keep head back against the seat headrest.

name: The Twilight Zone Tower of Terror
sensoryNotes: Haunted hotel elevator with multiple randomized rapid vertical freefall drops and upward launches creating stomach weightlessness.
adhdTip: Intense stomach-drop sensations. Prepare children who are cautious around heights or sudden falling motions.

name: Animation Academy
sensoryNotes: Hands-on indoor drawing workshop where an artist teaches guests to sketch classic Disney characters.
adhdTip: Calm, seated drawing activity that is excellent for decompressing.

name: Crush's Coaster
sensoryNotes: Spinning turtle shell coaster in the dark East Australian Current with unpredictable spins and drops.
adhdTip: Consistently long wait times. Use Single Rider or Premier Access to bypass 70+ minute queues.

name: Toy Soldiers Parachute Drop
sensoryNotes: Outdoor tower parachute drops with mild floating sensations and high views across Toy Story Playland.
adhdTip: Great step-up ride for kids building confidence toward Tower of Terror.

name: Ratatouille: The Adventure
sensoryNotes: Trackless 3D rat vehicles across giant kitchen floors with heat blast effects and water mists.
adhdTip: Smooth trackless motion. Can be enjoyed comfortably without 3D glasses if visual fatigue occurs.

name: RC Racer
sensoryNotes: Orange half-pipe shuttle coaster soaring 25 meters up and down with intense weightlessness.
adhdTip: Choose middle rows for milder thrills; back and front rows experience strong zero-G floating.

name: Slinky Dog Zigzag Spin
sensoryNotes: Gentle circular undulating caterpillar ride following Slinky Dog chasing his tail.
adhdTip: Mild and smooth; ideal first coaster-style experience for toddlers and sensitive kids.

name: Cars Quatre Roues Rallye
sensoryNotes: Spinning cars switching across rotating turntables in Radiator Springs.
adhdTip: Smooth whipping sensation as cars switch between turntables.

name: Cars ROAD TRIP
sensoryNotes: Open-air tram tour culminating in Cars-tastrophe Canyon with earthquake vibrations, fire bursts, and water flood.
adhdTip: Left side of the tram receives light water spray during the canyon flash flood sequence.

name: Avengers Assemble: Flight Force
sensoryNotes: Catapult launch roller coaster (0-60mph in 2.8s) with 3 inversions in near pitch-black space alongside Iron Man & Captain Marvel screens.
adhdTip: High acceleration launch with over-the-shoulder restraints. Keep head firmly back against headrest.

name: Spider-Man W.E.B. Adventure
sensoryNotes: Interactive 3D mission using gesture recognition where riders sling virtual webs with their hands.
adhdTip: Active physical arm movements. Suitable for kids with high energy who enjoy gamified attractions.

name: Flying Carpets Over Agrabah
sensoryNotes: Circular aerial carousel with levers to control carpet height and tilt angle.
adhdTip: Front seats control height; rear seats control pitch tilt.

name: Raiponce Tangled Spin
sensoryNotes: Family spinning boat attraction surrounded by floating lanterns and Tangled melodies.
adhdTip: Scenic lakeside views across Adventure Bay with gentle motion.

name: Frozen Ever After
sensoryNotes: Boat voyage through Arendelle to Elsa's Ice Palace with animatronics, music, and one short backwards/forward slope drop.
adhdTip: High-demand attraction. Consider Premier Access or heading here at morning park opening.

name: The Lion King: Rhythms of the Pride Lands
sensoryNotes: Indoor acrobatic musical in Frontierland Theater with tribal drums, high-wire gymnastics, and live singers.
adhdTip: High-decibel live drumming and singing. Sitting further back from the stage softens the acoustic impact.

name: Mickey and the Magician
sensoryNotes: Theatrical stage production in Animagique Theater with illusions, live Broadway singing, and character appearances.
adhdTip: Air-conditioned indoor seating with clear stage views across tiers. Arrive 25 minutes early for preferred seats.

name: TOGETHER: a Pixar Musical Adventure
sensoryNotes: Theatrical production with live orchestra, stage projection mapping, dancers, bubbles, and sensory effects.
adhdTip: Live orchestral elements create varied acoustics. Fast-moving visual sequences.

name: Stitch Live!
sensoryNotes: Interactive digital show where animated Stitch engages directly with audience members.
adhdTip: Children can sit on front floor mats for direct interaction. Showtimes alternate between English and French.

name: Disney Junior Dream Factory
sensoryNotes: Energetic singing and dancing stage production with Mickey, Minnie, Fancy Nancy, Timon, and Vampirina.
adhdTip: Ideal interactive stage production for toddlers and children ages 2 to 7.

name: Disney Stars on Parade
sensoryNotes: Daytime musical parade with mechanical floats, dancers, and a fire-breathing Maleficent steampunk dragon.
adhdTip: Main Street curbs fill up 45 minutes early. Stand near 'it's a small world' gates for easier post-parade exit.

name: Disney Electrical Sky Parade (Nightly Drone Show)
sensoryNotes: Hundreds of synchronized illuminated drones dancing over Sleeping Beauty Castle with electro-syntho-magnetic music.
adhdTip: High-altitude visual show. Viewing from back along Main Street gives a clearer sightline with fewer crowds.

name: Disney Tales of Magic (Nighttime Fireworks Finale)
sensoryNotes: Castle projection mapping, lasers, dancing water fountains, and loud fireworks.
adhdTip: Sudden loud firework booms and dense crowd density on Central Plaza. Ear defenders strongly advised.

name: A Million Splashes of Colour
sensoryNotes: Daytime musical show on Central Plaza stages with Mickey, Mirabel, Asha, and colorful floats.
adhdTip: Multiple performance pods around Central Plaza allow viewing without crowding onto the curb.

name: Mickey's Halloween Celebration
sensoryNotes: Upbeat harvest parade with Daisy, Donald, and Mickey on his Illusion Manor float in Phantom Manor attire.
adhdTip: Cheery seasonal parade with upbeat country music rather than scary Halloween effects.

name: Disney Electrical Sky Parade (Halloween Drone Edition)
sensoryNotes: October drone choreography painting glowing ghosts, pumpkins, and villainous silhouettes above the castle.
adhdTip: Occurs directly before the fireworks; secure a spot near Town Square to leave quickly after.

name: A Nightfall with Disney Villains
sensoryNotes: Twilight castle projection sequence where Maleficent, Ursula, Captain Hook, and Jafar take over the castle.
adhdTip: Short 10-minute projection sequence with spooky music and lighting effects.

name: Villainous Masters & Halloween Character Meets
sensoryNotes: Exclusive seasonal photo meets with Jack Skellington, Sally, Vampire Stitch, Cruella, and Gaston.
adhdTip: Lines build quickly; check the official app as soon as park gates open to queue or use virtual queues.

name: Mickey's Dazzling Christmas Parade!
sensoryNotes: Illuminated Christmas parade with toy soldiers, holiday floats, Santa Claus, and falling snow effects on Main Street.
adhdTip: Artificial snow falls on Main Street. Watch from Fantasyland if your child is sensitive to foam snow.

name: Magical Christmas Tree Lighting & Carolers
sensoryNotes: Mickey, Minnie, and Santa illuminate the 24-meter-tall Town Square Christmas tree with choral music.
adhdTip: Charming 15-minute dusk ceremony; stand near the Gazebo for comfortable sightlines.

name: "Let's Sing Christmas!" Musical Sing-Along
sensoryNotes: Festive sing-along musical in Videopolis Theater with Mickey, Minnie, Donald, and choir singers.
adhdTip: Indoor auditorium with extensive bench seating, perfect for taking a warm break while dining.

name: New Year's Eve Grand Countdown Fireworks (Dec 31st)
sensoryNotes: December 31st midnight celebration featuring seasonal DJ parties, giant fireworks, and castle projections.
adhdTip: Very loud midnight fireworks and dense crowds across both parks. Ear defenders mandatory for sensitive kids.

name: The Amazing Spider-Man Rooftop Stunt Show
sensoryNotes: Spider-Man performs acrobatics, flips, and banter on the W.E.B. building rooftop.
adhdTip: Casual outdoor viewing. Stand across near the Quinjet platform for clear elevated views.

name: Avengers Unite! & Warriors of Wakanda
sensoryNotes: Live martial arts battles atop the Quinjet platform with Black Widow, Black Panther, Okoye, and Thor.
adhdTip: Pop-up outdoor show with plenty of standing space around the campus courtyard.

name: Guardians of the Galaxy: Dance Challenge!
sensoryNotes: High-energy 80s pop music dance-off with Star-Lord and Gamora where kids are invited to dance.
adhdTip: Fun physical participation for energetic kids to release pent-up energy.
